* func_stats
.func f(x) {x*agauss(1, 0.1, 3)}
.func g(a, b) {a + aunif(b, 0.1)}
.func h(x) {x*2}
.func d(x) {x + x*agauss(0, 1, 1)}
.func unused(x) {agauss(x, 1, 1)}
.param p=f(2)

.subckt s n PARAMS: w=1k
R4 n 0 {f(w) + 1}
.ends s
V1 a 0 1
R1 a b {f(1k) + F( 2k )}
R2 b 0 {g(1, h(3)) + f(f(1))}
R3 b c {d(aunif(1k, 10))}
X1 c s
.op
.end
